from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted data from a single judgment document relevant to the task."""
    identifier: str | None = Field(description="The identifier or label of the document (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., '民事二审判决书', '行政再审审查裁定书')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
